caption: Dashboard on the free plan straight after sign-up: 25 credits, a 15 MB limit per file and the promise that results can be downloaded as CSV or Excel; the account email is hidden.
The uploaded invoice PDF with a Start Analysis button.
Our test invoice, AIBM-001-factuur.pdf, marked 'Analysis complete' about 15 seconds after upload; the account email is hidden.
Document list after the analysis: the credit counter has gone from 25 to 24; the account email is hidden.
Document detail page after the analysis: only the file name, the upload date and a 'Merge tables' menu, with no table, no values and no download button; the account email is hidden.
The Merge tables menu on the same empty document.
Pricing page as it opened: 'Yearly' is highlighted, but the cards show the monthly prices, Solo $25, Startup $59 and Business $99 a month; the account email is hidden.
After clicking 'Monthly' the cards show the yearly rates: Solo $20.83 a month ($250 billed yearly), Startup $49.16 ($590) and Business $82.5 ($990); the account email is hidden.
